text:
Samir: heads-up — we have a 30-node training run for evals next week. Can we get 8x A100s reserved in us-west1 for 72 hours? Need lead time so PM can notify customers.
Joanne: short answer: queue is backed up. current lead time for new reserved allocations in us-west1 is ~48-72h at the moment. we can try to prioritize but need a reason (urgent/cust-facing).
Samir: it's customer-facing feature validation, flagged urgent by product. I filed the reserve request this morning using the CLI: `reserve --pool prod-gpu --region us-west1 --count 8 --term 3d` — it shows 'pending' in the portal.
Joanne: saw that. Pending because billing hold triggered on the project after last month's overage. finance-bot posted an alert this AM. I'll ping finance to clear the hold if you can confirm cost center.
finance-bot: Auto-notice: Project redwood-evals (cc: infra-team) — billing hold due to unexpected 42% increase vs forecast. Invoice samples: `INV-2024-09-03: $23,742`, `INV-2024-09-10: $33,674`. Please provide allocation IDs for review.
Lila: for short-term we could swap to a cheaper instance shape in e.g. us-west2 (8x L40s) — similar throughput for inference evals, but training perf may drop ~10%. Also consider spot mix: 6 reserved + 2 spot to reduce cost while queue clears.
Samir: can ops do a region swap? the training container depends on nvlink topology; was hoping to avoid changes.
Kevin: ops-oncall here — region swap is possible but requires redeploy of the node group + network CIDR check. ETA ~2-3h if we approve. Need explicit go from product for the topology compromise.
Joanne: finance cleared a temporary uplift if you tag the runs with `project:evaluations:urgent` and `cost-center:premium-poc`. I'll add the note to the reserve request to push it up in the queue.
Samir: doing it now. added tags and updated the ticket: /reserve --note "project:evaluations:urgent cost-center:premium-poc"
finance-bot: Acknowledged. Temporary billing uplift approved until 2024-09-15 for allocation `alloc-74219`. Please attach invoice references after run completes.
Lila: if you want a lower-risk option, we can also carve 8x from the dev-dedicated pool (will spike dev costs) but no topology change. Workload owners need to sign off.
Kevin: if dev-dedicated is fine, I can do hot-allocate now. ping me `@Kevin` when ready.
Samir: going to confirm with product — will reply in 30m. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: FYI — monitoring will raise alerts if GPU pod preemption >5% during migration window. I'll set a temporary suppression for the next 6h once allocation is confirmed.
Joanne: updating queue status: moved `alloc-74219` to top-priority after tags and finance uplift. New estimated start: ~2h. I'll follow up when allocation transitions to 'active'.
Samir: excellent, appreciate the fast turnaround. will post results + final invoice lines when done.
Kevin: noted. once active I'll send kube node join command to Samir.
finance-bot: Reminder: please upload cost breakdown CSV to `#billing-uploads` channel after run for post-mortem.
Samir: will do.
